title: Add RecipesListView with search and collapsible sections
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesListView.swift. Calls RecipeDiscovery.scan(folderURL:) to get [FolderSection] and renders them as a List. Each Section header shows a folder SF Symbol and the section name with a collapse chevron (default expanded). .searchable(text: $query, prompt: 'Search recipes') filters rows case-insensitively by displayName; sections with zero matching rows are hidden. Empty folder shows EmptyStateView(systemImage: 'tray', title: 'No recipes found', subtitle: 'Add .cook files to <folderName>.'). Search no-match shows EmptyStateView(systemImage: 'magnifyingglass', title: 'No matches'). Tapping a row sets selectedRecipe: RecipeFile? and presents a .sheet(item: $selectedRecipe) with a placeholder VStack (displayName as .title, path as .body .secondary, 'Detailed view coming in 0004' caption), 'Done' toolbar button, and .large detent.
acceptance_criteria: Calls RecipeDiscovery.scan to load sections from the provided folderURL
List renders one Section per FolderSection with folder SF Symbol headers
Sections are collapsible with chevron disclosure; default state is expanded
.searchable modifier with prompt 'Search recipes' is applied
Search filters case-insensitively by displayName substring
Sections with zero matching rows are hidden during search
Empty folder state shows EmptyStateView with tray icon and folder name in subtitle
Search no-match state shows EmptyStateView with magnifyingglass icon and 'No matches' title
Row tap sets selectedRecipe and presents .sheet(item:) — not .sheet(isPresented:)
Placeholder sheet contains displayName (.title), path (.body .secondary), caption 'Detailed view coming in 0004'
Placeholder sheet has 'Done' trailing toolbar button and .large detent
